q1.p: What is included in the free trial?
q1.r: Up to {vagas} active roles, unlimited candidates, and full access to AI ranking. No credit card, no commitment.

q2.p: Do I need a credit card to start?
q2.r: No. The {dias} day trial does not ask for a card. An email address is enough to create your account.

q3.p: What happens when the trial ends?
q3.r: Your roles stop accepting new applications and the dashboard is locked until you subscribe. Nothing is deleted: pick a plan and everything comes back exactly as you left it.

q4.r: Yes. Upgrade or downgrade at any time, and the charge is prorated.

q5.p: Do candidates need to create an account?
q5.r: No. Candidates apply straight from the role link, with no signup. They upload a resume and answer your questions.

q6.r: Yes. Data is encrypted, we follow Brazilian privacy law (LGPD), and candidates can request deletion at any time.

q7.p: How does the AI ranking work?
q7.r: The AI reads the resume and the answers to your screening questions, then produces a Fit Score from 0 to 100. The higher the score, the closer the candidate is to what the role asks for.
